parameters.query:
-- Solo después de la prueba completa de cancelación en Pabau.
WITH entrada AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
prueba AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.j, e.j->'fila' AS f, e.j->'cancelacion' AS c FROM entrada e
  WHERE e.j->'cancelacion'->>'cancelacion_completa' = 'true'
),
origen AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.* FROM public.reservas_draft d, prueba e
  WHERE d.id::text = e.f->>'id' AND d.id::text = e.c->>'id'
    AND d.subscriber_id::text = e.f->>'subscriber_id'
    AND d.subscriber_id::text = e.c->>'subscriber_id'
    AND d.estado_reserva = 'expirado_sin_pago'
    AND d.bloqueo_liberacion_por_comprobante IS FALSE
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 /* COMPROBANTE_REGISTRADO_BLOQUEA_ARCHIVO */ FROM public.spa_comprobantes_pago c WHERE c.reserva_draft_id=d.id AND c.subscriber_id=d.subscriber_id::text)
    AND d.pago_recibido IS FALSE AND d.reserva_confirmada IS FALSE
    AND d.pabau_reservado IS FALSE AND d.retencion_cancelada_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.fecha_pago, '') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.evento_stripe_id, '') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.stripe_payment_intent_id, '') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(d.monto_pagado, 0) = 0
    AND d.sucursal = e.f->>'sucursal' AND d.sucursal = e.c->>'sucursal'
    AND d.servicio = e.f->>'servicio' AND d.servicio = e.c->>'servicio'
    AND d.jacuzzi_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (e.f->>'jacuzzi_inicio')::timestamp
    AND d.masaje_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (e.f->>'masaje_inicio')::timestamp
    AND d.jacuzzi_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (e.c->>'jacuzzi_inicio')::timestamp
    AND d.masaje_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (e.c->>'masaje_inicio')::timestamp
    AND COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, '[]'::jsonb) = COALESCE(e.c->'pabau_citas_agua_ids', '[]'::jsonb)
    AND COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids, '[]'::jsonb) = COALESCE(e.c->'pabau_citas_masaje_ids', '[]'::jsonb)
    AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
       + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids, '[]'::jsonb))) > 0
    AND jsonb_array_length(e.c->'cancelaciones_resultados') =
        jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
        + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
        COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, '[]'::jsonb) || COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids, '[]'::jsonb)
      ) AS a(id)
      WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.c->'cancelaciones_resultados') AS r(v)
        WHERE r.v->>'appointment_id' = a.id AND r.v->>'ok' = 'true') <> 1
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
      WHERE r.subscriber_id = d.subscriber_id AND r.sucursal = d.sucursal
        AND r.jacuzzi_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.jacuzzi_inicio
        AND r.masaje_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.masaje_inicio
        AND r.pago_recibido IS TRUE
        AND r.pabau_citas_agua_ids IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pabau_citas_agua_ids
        AND r.pabau_citas_masaje_ids IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids
    )
  FOR UPDATE OF d
),
archivada AS (
  INSERT INTO public.reservas_draft_historico
    (reserva_draft_id, datos_originales, retencion_pabau_at, pabau_confirmado_at, prueba_cancelacion)
  SELECT o.id, to_jsonb(o), o.retencion_pabau_at, o.pabau_confirmado_at, e.c
  FROM origen o CROSS JOIN prueba e
  ON CONFLICT (reserva_draft_id) DO UPDATE SET
    datos_originales = EXCLUDED.datos_originales,
    retencion_pabau_at = EXCLUDED.retencion_pabau_at,
    pabau_confirmado_at = EXCLUDED.pabau_confirmado_at,
    archivado_en = statement_timestamp(),
    prueba_cancelacion = EXCLUDED.prueba_cancelacion
  RETURNING reserva_draft_id
),
eliminada AS (
  DELETE FROM public.reservas_draft d USING origen o, archivada a WHERE d.id = o.id AND a.reserva_draft_id = d.id AND d.bloqueo_liberacion_por_comprobante IS FALSE
  RETURNING to_jsonb(d) AS borrador
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eliminada) THEN
  (SELECT borrador || jsonb_build_object('borrador_eliminado', true, 'borrador_archivado', true, 'tabla_archivo', 'reservas_draft_historico',
    'reserva_draft_id', borrador->>'id', 'cancelacion_completa', true) FROM eliminada)
  ELSE jsonb_build_object('borrador_eliminado', false,
    'error_limpieza', 'CANCELACION_NO_COMPROBADA_O_PAGO_POSTERIOR') END AS resultado;

parameters.query:
-- Liberación automática a las 2 horas sin pago.
-- Toma el bloqueo de cancelación sin correo ni decisión de asesora.
WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS draft_id, $2::text AS subscriber_id
),
bloqueada AS (
  UPDATE public.reservas_draft d SET
    estado_reserva = 'cancelando_expirada',
    motivo_revision = 'CANCELACION_AUTOMATICA_SIN_PAGO',
    procesando_desde = now()
  FROM entrada e
  WHERE d.id::text = e.draft_id
    AND d.subscriber_id::text = e.subscriber_id
    AND d.estado_reserva = 'pendiente_pago'
    AND d.motivo_revision = 'ESPERANDO_LIBERACION_2H'
    AND d.pago_recibido IS FALSE
    AND d.reserva_confirmada IS FALSE
    AND d.pabau_reservado IS TRUE
    AND d.bloqueo_liberacion_por_comprobante IS FALSE
    AND NULLIF(d.fecha_pago, '') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.evento_stripe_id, '') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(d.monto_pagado, 0) = 0
    AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
       + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids, '[]'::jsonb))) > 0
  RETURNING to_jsonb(d) AS fila
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'resultado',
  COALESCE((SELECT fila FROM bloqueada), '{}'::jsonb)
    || jsonb_build_object('cancelacion_adquirida', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bloqueada))
) AS resultado;
